apps.name: Archaea Hello
apps.tagline: A tiny test app that proves install, launch and update work.
apps.description:
Archaea Hello is the smallest possible real application. It opens a window showing its version and how many times it has been launched.

It exists so the launcher can be tested end to end against a genuine GitHub release. Install it, launch it, update it and remove it to see the whole lifecycle before the creative apps arrive.
apps.releaseNotes:
First release.
- Shows its version in a window
- Counts how many times it has been launched

A raster editor for retouching, compositing and digital painting, with layers, masks and non-destructive adjustments.

ArchaeaPhoto is planned as the first creative app in the suite.
